title: Health and Hearts
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about hit points, hearts and lives. A spike takes ten hit points, a heart gives ten back, and at zero a life is gone and the room starts again with a full 30. A smiling face adds a life. Press F2 to see the numbers. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a heart.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has three short levels to cross and 30 hit points to spend. Spikes take ten, hearts give ten back, and running out costs a life and starts the room again. Read the signs, press F2 to check the numbers, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a heart.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Spikes take hit points, hearts give them back, a face adds a life
Made to be copied and taken apart
